title.value: Posterior samples of source galaxies in strong gravitational lenses with score-based priors
title.justification: The title precisely indicates the focus of the study, which is the development and application of score-based priors for sampling posteriors of source galaxies in strong gravitational lenses.
title.quote: Posterior samples of source galaxies in strong gravitational lenses with score-based priors

extractions.description: This paper presents a method for inferring undistorted images of background galaxies in strong gravitational lenses using a score-based model. The model treats the posterior sampling of distorted images as a high-dimensional inference problem, utilizing a reverse-time stochastic differential equation solver. This approach balances the likelihood of the observed data with a prior based on high-resolution training data, leading to high-quality samples aligned with physical plausibility. The paper explores the application to gravitational lensing, providing insights into astrophysical phenomena.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central focus of the paper is on astrophysical applications of inferring galaxy images rather than climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Strong gravitational lensing – extreme distortions in the images of distant sources by the gravity of foreground lensing galaxies – is a powerful tool that can be used to probe the fundamental nature of dark matter, infer the expansion rate of the universe, and study the birth and evolution of nascent galaxies [1].

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily discusses astrophysical topics related to gravitational lensing and does not focus on climate or ecological sustainable development.
primary_category.quote: In this work, we use score-based modeling, formulated in terms of stochastic differential equations (SDEs), to learn a highly-accurate prior over the source surface brightness for lensing analysis.

secondary_categories.justification: No secondary categories relate to sustainable development as the paper's content is centered on astrophysical techniques and does not link to climate or ecology.
secondary_categories.quote: Inferring accurate posteriors for high-dimensional representations of the brightness of gravitationally-lensed sources is a major challenge, in part due to the difficulties of accurately quantifying the priors.

primary_sub_category.quote: This model is trained on a set of high-resolution images of undistorted galaxies.

secondary_sub_categories.quote: Our method produces independent posterior samples and models the data almost down to the noise level.

applications.value: Astrophysical inference of galaxy images through gravitational lensing
applications.justification: This is the core application highlighted in the paper, where the methodology aids in understanding and reconstructing images of galaxies affected by strong gravitational lensing.
applications.quote: Inferring the spatial distribution of mass in the foreground lens and the spatial distribution of surface brightness in the background source is an essential component of achieving these scientific goals.
